summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares nadofaragene firadenovec with usual care treatments for high-grade non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) in people whose BCG treatment has failed. Usual care for randomized patients is intravesical gemcitabine plus docetaxel (GemDoce), and the record also lists other standard options such as mitomycin, BCG re-treatment, and pembrolizumab. Nadofaragene firadenovec is instilled into the bladder every 3 months for up to 12 months, and GemDoce is given weekly for 6 weeks for induction, then monthly for up to 24 months for those with a complete response. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is described as comparing effectiveness.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara nadofaragene firadenovec con tratamientos de atención habitual para el cáncer de vejiga no músculo invasivo (CVNMI) de alto grado, en personas cuyo tratamiento con BCG ha fallado. La atención habitual para los pacientes asignados es gemcitabina más docetaxel (GemDoce) por vía intravesical, y el registro también menciona otras opciones estándar, como mitomicina, nuevo tratamiento con BCG y pembrolizumab. Nadofaragene firadenovec se instila en la vejiga cada 3 meses durante hasta 12 meses, y GemDoce se administra semanalmente durante 6 semanas como inducción, y luego mensualmente durante hasta 24 meses en quienes tienen respuesta completa. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio se describe como una comparación de efectividad.
who_for: High-grade non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (Tis, Ta, or T1) under care of a participating urologist.
One or more BCG induction courses, and the treating urologist judges that BCG has failed.
Received at least one intravesical or systemic NMIBC treatment in the previous 12 months, with some timing allowances for TURBT.
Treating urologist sees no contraindication to nadofaragene firadenovec and is uncertain whether it is better than best usual care.
not_for: Currently receiving an experimental therapy for NMIBC in a clinical trial.
